summary.title: MaintainableCSS - an approach to writing modular, scalable and maintainable CSS
summary.one_liner: MaintainableCSS is an approach to writing modular, scalable CSS so that pre-existing styles do not cause problems as a codebase grows.
takeaways: MaintainableCSS is presented as an approach for writing modular, scalable and maintainable CSS.
The goal is to write CSS without worrying that overzealous, pre-existing styles will cause problems.
The page is a promotional landing page; it names the approach but the text provided gives few concrete technical details.
